paragraph: Did he **specify** the reason for his delay? The regulations **specify** that lifts should be serviced. Why do you need to **specify** which kind you're talking about?
english: to state exactly

paragraph: Two men engaging in sexual activity still creates **controversy**. He has a taste for **controversy** for its own sake. The book sparked **controversy** in the press and academic circles.
english: a debate or discussion of opposing opinions

paragraph: I see the world through a **lens** of possibility. Will you find my contact **lens** for me? Everyone looks at everything through their own **lens**.
english: an object, usually made of glass, that focuses or defocuses the light that passes through it

paragraph: How much confidence exists that this **assumption** is correct? Your **assumption** that I love food is correct. More direct observation is needed to confirm this **assumption**, however.
english: something believed without proof

paragraph: Only one **stack** had a real bill on top. There is a **stack** of letters on the table. I loaded a **stack** of wood on my back.
english: a pile

paragraph: I am climbing a **palm** tree. We are climbing the **palm** tree. Some date **palm** trees survived.
english: the inner and somewhat concave part of the human hand or other primate hand that extends from the wrist to the bases of the fingers

paragraph: The **installation** of the application can take some minutes. The **installation** is now complete. The military forces will guard critical **installations**.
english: putting equipment in place

paragraph: The **Socialist** Party only got 18% of the votes. A communist is a **socialist** without a sense of humor. I think the **socialist** party will win.
english: of, relating to, supporting, or advocating socialism

other.meaning: One who supports or advocates socialism (noun)

paragraph: He's a man who has a **preference** for women. I don't know your **preference**, so please help yourself. He should be given **preference** over the others.
english: the option to so select, and the one selected

paragraph: **Bend** your knees and look in front of you. Keep your eye on the ball. **Bend** your knees. He can't make time **bend** depending on his wishes.
english: to cause (something) to change its shape into a curve, by physical force, chemical action, or any other means

paragraph: How can you have a **laptop** and not a cell phone? Let me take your **laptop**, please. Mine is broken. Remember to shut down your **laptop** properly after use.
english: a laptop computer
arabicDesc: مثال: كيف يكون عندك لابتوب ولا يكون عندك جوال؟

paragraph: South Africa did away with its nuclear **arsenal**. The army surrendered its **arsenal** to the enemy. **Arsenal** is my favourite football team.
english: a military establishment for the storing, development, manufacturing, testing, or repairing of arms, ammunition, and other war materiel

paragraph: My greatest desire was to meet my **biological** father. We have three adopted children and two **biological** children. Do souls have races independent of their **biological** race?
english: of or relating to biology

paragraph: Everyone, without any **discrimination**, has the right to equal pay for equal work. They are poor because of the **discrimination** against them. **Discrimination** made it difficult for me to find a job.
english: distinct treatment of an individual or group to their disadvantage
arabicDesc: مثال: لكل فرد دون أي تمييز الحق في أجرٍ متساوٍ للعمل.

other.meaning: the act of making a distinction, noting differences between things

paragraph: It might change the **dynamic** of our relationship. Maybe, we could explore a power **dynamic** like boss and employee. The American culture is so **dynamic**.
english: full of energy; always changing

paragraph: They will figure out the location from the surveillance **footage**. He reviewed the **footage** frame by frame. Don't watch nuclear test **footage** all day.
english: film of an event

paragraph: They are crazy about **jazz**. Did you hear that they canceled that **jazz** festival? Which are you better at playing, **jazz** or rock?
english: musical art form
arabicDesc: مثال: إنهم يعشقون موسيقى الجاز بجنون.

paragraph: No one was aware of her **literary** talent. A group of writers has value in **literary** history. Reading **literary** criticism is very helpful to understanding literature.
english: relating to literature
arabicDesc: مثال: لا أحد انتبه لبراعتها الأدبية.

paragraph: Get back before **midnight** or you'll be locked out. I don't usually to go to bed before **midnight**. Despite it being **midnight**, the children are still up.
english: middle of the night

paragraph: I can't understand the **psychology** of such a man. In the matter of **psychology**, he is an expert. This is a fundamental error in thinking about **psychology**.
english: the study of the human mind

other.meaning: the study of human or animal behavior

paragraph: Financial **stability** is important, but so is personal growth. They fought to maintain peace and **stability** in the galaxy. Federal grants have also contributed to economic growth and **stability**.
english: the condition of being stable or in equilibrium, and thus resistant to change

paragraph: He doesn't have a **steady** girlfriend at the moment. The immigrants entered the country in a **steady** flow. The patient is on a **steady** road to recovery.
english: firm in standing or position

paragraph: We can't rule that out, but it seems **unlikely**. Everyone believes in victory, even when this is **unlikely**. It's **unlikely** that the meeting will start on time.
english: not likely

paragraph: **Nominate** now the champion of gender-balanced business. Who would you **nominate** for this award? I would like to **nominate** myself.
english: to name someone as a candidate for a particular role or position, including that of an office

paragraph: I like to **invent** useful things. I wonder who **invented** it. If you didn't exist, then I would **invent** you.
english: design a new process or mechanism

paragraph: I do a **lap** around the lake every morning. You could sit on my **lap** if you want. Sorry, I can't. My cat is on my **lap**.
english: the loose part of a coat

other.meaning: To take (liquid) into the mouth with the tongue (verb)

paragraph: I don't want to be a **burden** to you. I'm afraid that I'll be a **burden** to you. Supporting his family was a great **burden** for him.
english: a heavy load

paragraph: I **burst** out laughing when I saw him. The entire crowd **burst** out laughing. A sudden **burst** of energy helped me pull through.
english: to break open suddenly

paragraph: The tourists had to leave the town before **dawn**. We reached the top of the hill at **dawn**. The party was brought to a close before **dawn**.
english: to begin to brighten with daylight
arabicDesc: مثال: وجب على السياح مغادرة البلدة قبل حلول الفجر .

other.meaning: The morning twilight period immediately before sunrise (noun)

paragraph: Then he would give his letters to another **rider**. The **rider** stopped at an inn during his travels. The horse is often smarter than its **rider**.
english: a mounted person

paragraph: It just takes a **spark** to light a fire. You need to learn how to change **spark** plugs. A powerful flame is caused by a tiny **spark**.
english: a small particle of glowing matter, either molten or on fire, resulting from an electrical surge or excessive heat created by friction

paragraph: Can you please tell me what time the train **leaves**? **Leaves** were being disturbed on the forest floor. In autumn, **leaves** change their color and fall.
english: the usually green and flat organ that represents the most prominent feature of most vegetative plants
arabicDesc: مثال: أيمكنك أن تخبرني متى يغادر القطار؟

paragraph: You only have to slide it into the **slot**. I don't like to play on the **slot** machines. The network is moving your show to another time **slot**.
english: a narrow opening; also a time for something

paragraph: Many goods are transported across the **globe** by ship. The **globe** is similar in shape to an orange. That's my **globe**! I put it where I please.
english: any spherical (or nearly spherical) object

paragraph: It sounds like a radio soap **opera**. He got addicted to that soap **opera**. This is my favorite soap **opera**.
english: theatrical work
arabicDesc: مثال: يبدو هذا كمسلسل درامي إذاعي.

paragraph: What are the most **frequent** words in this language? The teacher was worried by his **frequent** absence from class. The trains are less **frequent** at night time.
english: done or occurring often

paragraph: I don't have time to make you a **sandwich**. Please don't forget to bring a **sandwich**. What kind of **sandwich** do you want?
english: dish — see also open sandwich
arabicDesc: مثال: لا وقت لديّ لتحضير شطيرة لك.

paragraph: My mother is an **architect**. I have a friend whose mother is an **architect**. He is the greatest **architect** that has ever lived.
english: designer of buildings

paragraph: They were forced to **withdraw**. He **withdrew** his hand from the table. I forgot my PIN and can't **withdraw** any money.
english: to extract (money) from a bank account or other financial deposit

paragraph: Now, just let the **clay** slide between your fingers. He was making a horse out of the **clay**. He made a little statue out of soft **clay**.
english: a mineral substance made up of small crystals of silica and alumina, that is ductile when moist

paragraph: We're going to **extract** the oil from our plants. How do we **extract** the coal from the ground? How can I **extract** the audio from a video clip?
english: something that is extracted or drawn out

other.meaning: solution made by drawing out from a substance

paragraph: I think any **genre** of music can be good. What **genre** of music do you like the most? Which movie **genre** do you prefer? Comedy or drama?
english: a kind

paragraph: My **intent** is to return directly to my home. They are **intent** on destroying and eliminating the natives. The child did not **intent** to break your arm.
english: something that is intended

paragraph: The young doctor **devoted** himself to helping the poor and sick. He **devoted** his whole life to science. She **devoted** her life to music.
english: to give one's time, focus one's efforts, commit oneself, etc. entirely for, on, or to a certain matter
arabicDesc: مثال: كرّسَ الطبيبَ الشابَ نفسهُ لمساعدةِ الفقراءِ والمرضى.

paragraph: The **collective** West has been cheating us for centuries. The consequence of individual crimes should be **collective** punishment. Respect for the law is essential for **collective** happiness.
english: done by a group together

paragraph: The only thing that can save humanity is **cooperation**. With their **cooperation**, the mission had been successfully finished. Every language is a record of conflict and **cooperation**.
english: the act of cooperating

paragraph: The room was in complete **darkness**. **Darkness** will cover the world. She managed to run away under cover of **darkness**.
english: state of being dark

paragraph: Sometimes I see the cat at the **hardware** store. There is a **hardware** store not far from here. The only drivers for this **hardware** are not open source.
english: equipment

paragraph: The newspaper alleged his **involvement** in the crime. He denied having any **involvement** in the incident. I heard of his **involvement** in crime.
english: taking part in something

paragraph: I fear that this may be **partly** true. This road was **partly** destroyed in consequence of the earthquake. I think you're **partly** to blame for the negotiation breakdown.
english: to some degree; not completely

paragraph: Eating without being **physically** active leads to weight gain. It is **physically** impossible to control the whole world. I need you to be **physically** close to me.
english: relating to the body

paragraph: Society must do away with laws which cause **racial** discrimination. Not every racist country has the same **racial** classification system. **Racial** discrimination in the West Bank needs to be deeply explored.
english: of or relating to a race (or a people)

paragraph: They think **similarly** but come to different conclusions. All of you behave **similarly**. All of the men were dressed **similarly** to Tom.
english: in a similar way

paragraph: I agree with you that the actor is very **talented**. If you're not **talented** then at least be interesting! They discovered a very **talented** player during summer training.
english: having a natural ability
arabicDesc: مثال: أوافقك الرأي أن الممثل موهوب جدا.

paragraph: Take **wisdom** from the mouths of crazy people. My upper right **wisdom** tooth hurts. Take **wisdom** wherever you find it.
english: element of personal character
arabicDesc: مثال: خذ الحكمة من أفواه المجانين.

paragraph: My computer is connected to a properly grounded **outlet**. He needs a more productive **outlet** for his anger. America is just one giant **outlet** store mall.
english: a way to express feelings; a shop; an electric socket

paragraph: This bridge has become our national **icon**. To change the flag, click on the flag **icon**. To adopt a sentence, click on the white person **icon**.
english: an image, symbol, picture, portrait, or other representation, usually as an object of religious devotion
arabicDesc: مثال: أصبح هذا الجسر رمزنا الوطني.

paragraph: The economy of the island is **dependent** on the fishing industry. Even though he's 38, he's still **dependent** on his parents. I don't want to be **dependent** on my parents.
english: relying upon
arabicDesc: مثال: يعتمد اقتصاد الجزيرة على صناعة الصيد.

paragraph: They explored the desert in **quest** of buried treasure. We hope you will join us in our **quest**. And just like that, the **quest** began.
english: a journey or effort in pursuit of a goal (often lengthy, ambitious, or fervent)

paragraph: He leans to the left side of the political **spectrum**. The number of legs in humans is on a **spectrum**. Opponents of the bill come from across the political **spectrum**.
english: a range

paragraph: My ear was **bleeding** this morning. A doctor quickly cut off his left arm and stopped the heavy **bleeding**. Turn off this song, it makes my ears **bleed**.
english: lose blood
arabicDesc: مثال: الأذنان كانا ينزفان دماً صباح اليوم.

paragraph: I had no idea you worked as a **surgeon**. The **surgeon** advised me to go to hospital immediately. Besides being a **surgeon**, he was a famous writer.
english: one who performs surgery

paragraph: We are a **particle** of the universe. He knew this picture by heart, every minute **particle** of it. Is light a wave or a **particle**?
english: a very small piece of matter, a fragment

paragraph: We are going to try a different **tactic**. That reverse psychology **tactic** isn't going to work with me. I still haven't decided which **tactic** I'll use.
english: a maneuver, or action calculated to achieve some end

other.meaning: military manoeuvre used against an enemy

paragraph: **Rub** salt in the wound. I **rubbed** his spots with these leaves. Children often **rub** their eyes when they are tired.
english: to move one object while maintaining contact with another object over some area

paragraph: The country was governed by a French **noble** family. What a **noble** heart that good man has! To protect the innocent without exception is a **noble** cause.
english: an aristocrat

paragraph: Don't add sentences from **copyrighted** sources. If you don't believe in **copyright**, it can't hurt you. **Copyright** only exists if you want it to.
english: such an exclusive right as it pertains to one or more specific works
arabicDesc: مثال: لا تضف جملا من مصادر محفوظة الحقوق.

paragraph: The simple **perception** of natural forms is a delight. Between two people there is no truth, only **perception**. Our **perception** of beauty has changed over time.
english: the organisation, identification and interpretation of sensory information

paragraph: The **admission** is ten dollars a person. Give this **admission** ticket to someone who wants it. There is no **admission** fee for children under five.
english: being allowed to enter; the cost of entry; admitting something
arabicDesc: مثال: سعر الدخول عشرة دولارات للشخص الواحد.

paragraph: This **medication** could knock out a horse. This **medication** is ruining my life. It is extremely important to stay on your **medication**.
english: one or all the medicines regularly taken by a patient
arabicDesc: مثال: بإمكان هذا الدّواء تنويم حصان.

paragraph: Is this hugging and kissing standard **protocol**, too? How can I draw up the **protocol** correctly? Just stick to the **protocol**, would you?
english: an amendment to an official treaty

paragraph: Did you get the **scholarship** that you applied for? He studied hard with a view to gaining a **scholarship**. The **scholarship** enabled her to go to university.
english: a grant-in-aid to a student

paragraph: He never really talked about his **conversion** to Islam. If **conversion** therapy worked, I would go for it. He didn't mention his **conversion** to Islam to anybody.
english: changing something from one form to another

paragraph: I should very much appreciate a **prompt** reply. We look forward to receiving your **prompt** reply. Your **prompt** attention to this matter will be greatly appreciated.
english: quick

paragraph: You have to **seize** the opportunity with both hands. The British forces were ordered to **seize** the weapons. You have no legal right to **seize** my property.
english: to deliberately take hold of

paragraph: Can you get this **arrow** out of my leg? A word spoken is an **arrow** let fly. The **arrow** missed him and hit a tree.
english: a projectile consisting of a shaft, a point and a tail with stabilizing fins that is shot from a bow

paragraph: I don't make the rules. I just **enforce** them. How are they going to **enforce** that law? The government must **enforce** the law immediately.
english: to make people obey a law

paragraph: **Echo** was very happy that his mother had returned. Your life is the **echo** of your mental attitude. Your eyes reflect the **echo** of my voice.
english: a reflected sound that is heard again by its initial observer

paragraph: The **dip** burned my tongue. We took a **dip** in the lake after lying in the sun for a while. We had to **dip** into our savings in order to pay the unexpected medical expenses.
english: to lower into a liquid — see also dunk

paragraph: We all hope that this **cease**-fire will make for world peace. To live without hope is to **cease** to live. Should the **cease**-fire be allowed to break down completely?
english: to stop
arabicDesc: مثال: نأمل جميعًا أن يأتي وقف إطلاق النار هذا بسلام عالمي.

paragraph: Where does all this **rage** come from? The sea was **raging** against them more and more. Every fiber of my being is consumed by **rage**.
english: act in an angry manner
arabicDesc: مثال: من أين أتى كل هذا الغضب؟

paragraph: Choose a travelling **companion**, and only then a route. My only **companion** on the trip was my dog. In the year 1957, our planet received a new **companion**.
english: a friend, acquaintance or partner

paragraph: I have to take my car to the **mechanic**. Take it to a **mechanic**, and get it fixed. The **mechanic** said the repair would not take long.
english: skilled worker on machinery

paragraph: Why is your nose **bloody**? A **bloody** knife was discovered at the crime scene. I was standing behind that **bloody** counter for 16 hours, 16 hours!
english: covered in blood

paragraph: This is a small **tribute** to all my teachers. We could pay a little **tribute** to him. Pay **tribute** to those who deserve it.
english: an acknowledgment of gratitude, respect or admiration

other.meaning: payment made by a feudal vassal to his lord

paragraph: I woke up in a cold **sweat**. She raised me with the **sweat** of her labor. I worked up a good **sweat** at the gym.
english: fluid that exits the body through pores
arabicDesc: مثال: استيقظتُ وأنا أتصببُ عرقاً بارداً.

paragraph: The treaty gave the United States a **canal** zone. He slept near a **canal** in the grass. A **canal** flowed between two rows of houses.
english: an artificial waterway or artificially improved river used for travel, shipping, or irrigation

paragraph: He booked a room for me at the **inn**. That **inn** by the sea has a nice view. Follow this road and you'll come to the **inn**.
english: any establishment where travellers can procure lodging, food, and drink

paragraph: I came into the world on a **pirate** ship. I saw a man dressed like a **pirate**. Boarding a **pirate** ship could be dangerous for your life.
english: a criminal who plunders at sea

paragraph: Actually, it's really more of a **guideline** than a rule. These are just **guidelines**, not hard and fast rules. To help ensure accident-free operation, follow these **guidelines**.
english: a non-specific rule or principle that provides direction to action or behaviour

paragraph: We need to understand the **scope** of the problem. The problem is beyond the **scope** of my understanding. When making a video game, keep your **scope** small.
english: the breadth, depth or reach of a subject

paragraph: I can't break free of her **grip** on me. The Catholic Church had a strong **grip** on society. He adjusted his **grip** on the bat before batting.
english: a hold or way of holding, particularly with the hand

paragraph: The general meeting began at 9 am on the **dot**. The remains of human cities **dot** the Earth. The plane was just a tiny **dot** in the sky.
english: a small round mark

paragraph: I feel **awkward** in his presence. Sleeping in the same room with him is **awkward**. That is an **awkward** amount of weight to carry.
english: embarrassing or difficult; not easy to use

paragraph: I found some dried salted **beef**. The Japanese eat more **beef** than the British do. The ground **beef** was found to contain horse meat.
english: the meat from cattle or other bovines
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا وجدت بعض لحم البقر المجفف المملح.

paragraph: She had the **distinct** feeling that something was up. He has no **distinct** idea of how to proceed. Your way of thinking is quite **distinct** from mine.
english: clearly different; easy to notice

paragraph: Unfortunately, you are no longer **eligible** for the prize. **Eligible** community members are encouraged to submit their applications online. I became **eligible** for retirement earlier than expected.
english: allowed to do or receive something

paragraph: There are **fifty** members in this club. The club has more than **fifty** members. It's not that easy to learn a new language after **fifty**.
english: cardinal number
arabicDesc: مثال: في هذا النادي خمسون عضوا.

paragraph: There was absolutely no **furniture** in that room. We rented a truck to move our **furniture**. The **furniture** used to be different in this room.
english: large movable items
arabicDesc: مثال: لم يكن هناك أي أثاث في الغرفة على الإطلاق.

paragraph: In my opinion, horses are very **intelligent** animals. Everybody knows that we're more **intelligent** than she is. He is not as **intelligent** as his older brother.
english: of high or especially quick cognitive capacity, bright
arabicDesc: مثال: في رأي ،الخيول حيوانات ذكية جدا .
